steps.message:
# Agentic RL environment fan-out diagnosis

Review the staged public Miles + Harbor + MiniSWE historical snapshot. Inspect
the launcher, agent-environment control flow, MiniSWE 2.4.6 source, TITO-v2
tree semantics, rollout records, trial trajectories, and frozen run metrics.

Do not launch another training run, start SGLang, create sandboxes, download a
model or dataset, use the network, or modify the historical snapshot. The
dataset, model, task selection, response cap, and one-step training budget are
fixed.

## Deliverable

Write one concise UTF-8 diagnosis to:

```text
$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/agent_answer.md
```

State the health verdict, identify the concrete root cause, and explain the
causal chain from agent request-history behavior through TITO-v2 tree
attachment and training-leaf accounting. Quote the exact logical-rollout,
training-leaf, inflation, fan-out, maximum-leaves, mismatch, and sample-status
values from the frozen metrics.

Rule out launcher and parser configuration, sandbox transport, task selection,
and residual tokenization mismatches before attributing the accounting result.
Do not merge unrelated symptoms into one unproven cause, and do not propose or
implement a fix.
I’ll inspect the staged snapshot and frozen metrics, then write the diagnosis without modifying the snapshot or starting any services.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run one normal 8-GPU Miles/Harbor GRPO update and summarize the observation.
set -euo pipefail

WS="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
: "${AUTORLBENCH_PREPARED:=$WS/.prepared}"
: "${AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS:=/tmp/miles-miniswe-harbor}"
mkdir -p "$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/experiment_logs"

if [ -f "$AUTORLBENCH_PREPARED/env" ]; then
  set -a
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$AUTORLBENCH_PREPARED/env"
  set +a
fi

: "${MODEL_PATH:?set MODEL_PATH to the Qwen3-30B-A3B HF checkpoint}"
: "${SESSION_SERVER_EXTERNAL_HOST:?set SESSION_SERVER_EXTERNAL_HOST to a host the sandboxes can reach}"
: "${HARBOR_ENV_TYPE:=e2b}"
: "${SANDBOX_BACKEND:=tencent_ags}"
: "${MILES_SOURCE_DIR:?MILES_SOURCE_DIR is written by environment/prepare.sh}"
: "${MEGATRON_PATH:?MEGATRON_PATH is written by environment/prepare.sh}"
: "${MILES_MODEL_BASE:=$AUTORLBENCH_PREPARED/models}"
: "${MODEL_NAME:=Qwen3-30B-A3B-autorlbench}"
: "${MILES_PROMPT_DATA:=$WS/data/miles_prompts.jsonl}"
: "${HARBOR_TASKS_DIR:=$WS/harbor_tasks}"
: "${HARBOR_TRIALS_DIR:=$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/harbor_trials}"
: "${MILES_DUMP_DIR:=$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/dump_details}"
: "${MILES_HOST_IP:=0.0.0.0}"
: "${EXPECTED_LOGICAL_ROLLOUTS:=64}"
: "${RUN_MODE:=normal}"

if [ "$HARBOR_ENV_TYPE" != "e2b" ]; then
  echo "[run] this package currently expects HARBOR_ENV_TYPE=e2b; got $HARBOR_ENV_TYPE" >&2
  exit 2
fi

if [ "$SANDBOX_BACKEND" != "tencent_ags" ] && [ "$SANDBOX_BACKEND" != "e2b" ]; then
  echo "[run] SANDBOX_BACKEND must be tencent_ags or e2b; got $SANDBOX_BACKEND" >&2
  exit 2
fi

if [ "$SANDBOX_BACKEND" = "tencent_ags" ]; then
  : "${TENCENT_AGS_TEMPLATE:?set TENCENT_AGS_TEMPLATE to the fixed Tencent AGS template}"
  if [ -n "${TENCENT_AGS_DOMAIN:-}" ]; then
    E2B_DOMAIN="${E2B_DOMAIN:-$TENCENT_AGS_DOMAIN}"
    export E2B_DOMAIN
  fi
  if [ -n "${TENCENT_AGS_URL:-}" ]; then
    E2B_API_URL="${E2B_API_URL:-$TENCENT_AGS_URL}"
    export E2B_API_URL
  fi
  if [ -z "${E2B_API_URL:-}" ] && [ -n "${E2B_DOMAIN:-}" ]; then
    E2B_API_URL="https://api.${E2B_DOMAIN}"
    export E2B_API_URL
  fi
  if [ -z "${E2B_DOMAIN:-}" ] && [ -z "${E2B_SANDBOX_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "[run] Tencent AGS needs TENCENT_AGS_DOMAIN (or E2B_SANDBOX_URL for a custom data plane)" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  : "${TENCENT_AGS_IMAGE_REGISTRY_TYPE:=enterprise}"
  : "${TENCENT_AGS_FORCE_HTTP1:=0}"
  : "${TENCENT_AGS_AGENT_WHEELHOUSE_TAR:?set TENCENT_AGS_AGENT_WHEELHOUSE_TAR to a Python 3.10 wheelhouse tar.gz}"
  export TENCENT_AGS_TEMPLATE
  export TENCENT_AGS_IMAGE_REWRITE="${TENCENT_AGS_IMAGE_REWRITE:-}"
  export TENCENT_AGS_IMAGE_REGISTRY_TYPE
  export TENCENT_AGS_FORCE_HTTP1
  export TENCENT_AGS_AGENT_WHEELHOUSE_TAR
fi

TEMP_E2B_KEY_FILE=""
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$TEMP_E2B_KEY_FILE" ] && [ -f "$TEMP_E2B_KEY_FILE" ]; then
    rm -f "$TEMP_E2B_KEY_FILE"
  fi
  ray stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [ -n "${E2B_API_KEY:-}" ]; then
  if [ -z "${E2B_API_KEY_FILE:-}" ]; then
    E2B_API_KEY_FILE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/miles-miniswe-e2b-key.XXXXXX")"
    TEMP_E2B_KEY_FILE="$E2B_API_KEY_FILE"
  fi
  if [ ! -s "$E2B_API_KEY_FILE" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$E2B_API_KEY" > "$E2B_API_KEY_FILE"
    chmod 600 "$E2B_API_KEY_FILE"
  fi
  export E2B_API_KEY_FILE
  unset E2B_API_KEY
fi

if [ -z "${E2B_API_KEY:-}" ] && [ -z "${E2B_API_KEY_FILE:-}" ]; then
  echo "[run] set E2B_API_KEY or E2B_API_KEY_FILE for the E2B-compatible sandbox" >&2
  exit 2
fi

export HARBOR_ENV_TYPE
export HARBOR_TASKS_DIR
export HARBOR_TRIALS_DIR
export AGENT_MODEL_NAME=model
export AGENT_TIMEOUT=5400
export AGENT_TRIAL_TIMEOUT=7200
export AGENT_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=28672
export AGENT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=4096
export HARBOR_MAX_SEQ_LEN=32768
export MILES_HOST_IP
export MILES_DUMP_DIR
export EXPECTED_LOGICAL_ROLLOUTS
export PYTHONPATH="$WS:$MILES_SOURCE_DIR:$MILES_SOURCE_DIR/examples/experimental/harbor:$MILES_SOURCE_DIR/examples/swe-agent-harbor-docker${HARBOR_SOURCE_DIR:+:$HARBOR_SOURCE_DIR/src}${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"

skip_prepare_args=()
if [ "${MILES_SKIP_PREPARE:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  skip_prepare_args=(--skip-prepare)
fi

mkdir -p "$MILES_DUMP_DIR" "$HARBOR_TRIALS_DIR"
driver_log="$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/experiment_logs/driver_$(date -u +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).log"

set +e
python3 "$WS/run_miles.py" \
  --mode "$RUN_MODE" \
  --sandbox-backend "$SANDBOX_BACKEND" \
  --num-gpus-per-node 8 \
  --megatron-path "$MEGATRON_PATH" \
  --base-dir "$MILES_MODEL_BASE" \
  --model-name "$MODEL_NAME" \
  --hf-checkpoint "$MODEL_PATH" \
  --prompt-data "$MILES_PROMPT_DATA" \
  --save-traces-dir "$MILES_DUMP_DIR" \
  --harbor-tasks-dir "$HARBOR_TASKS_DIR" \
  --harbor-trials-dir "$HARBOR_TRIALS_DIR" \
  "${skip_prepare_args[@]}" \
  2>&1 | tee "$driver_log"
STATUS="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
set -e

python3 "$WS/summarize_run.py"
SUMMARY_STATUS=$?

if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
  exit "$STATUS"
fi
exit "$SUMMARY_STATUS"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Launch the Miles + Harbor + mini-swe-agent GRPO observation run."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shlex
import subprocess
import time
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

import typer

from launch_common import agentic_pythonpath_dirs, harbor_env_vars
from miles.utils.external_utils import command_utils


@dataclass
class ScriptArgs(command_utils.ExecuteTrainConfig):
    mode: Literal["normal", "debug_rollout_only"] = "normal"
    run_id: str = command_utils.create_run_id()
    megatron_model_type: str = "qwen3-30B-A3B"
    num_gpus_per_node: int = 8
    megatron_path: str = os.environ.get("MEGATRON_PATH", "/root/Megatron-LM")

    skip_prepare: bool = False
    base_dir: str = os.environ.get("MILES_MODEL_BASE", "/tmp/miles-models")
    model_name: str = os.environ.get("MODEL_NAME", "Qwen3-30B-A3B-autorlbench")
    hf_checkpoint: str = os.environ.get("MODEL_PATH", "")
    ref_load: str = os.environ.get("MILES_REF_LOAD", "")
    prompt_data: str = os.environ.get(
        "MILES_PROMPT_DATA",
        str(Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "miles_prompts.jsonl"),
    )
    save_traces_dir: str = os.environ.get("MILES_DUMP_DIR", "")

    max_seq_len: int = 32768
    num_rollout: int = 1
    rollout_batch_size: int = int(os.environ.get("ROLLOUT_BATCH_SIZE", "16"))
    n_samples_per_prompt: int = int(os.environ.get("N_SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT", "4"))
    global_batch_size: int = int(os.environ.get("GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE", "64"))

    harbor_env_type: str = os.environ.get("HARBOR_ENV_TYPE", "")
    harbor_env_kwargs: str = os.environ.get("HARBOR_ENV_KWARGS", "{}")
    sandbox_backend: str = os.environ.get("SANDBOX_BACKEND", "tencent_ags")
    harbor_tasks_dir: str = os.environ.get("HARBOR_TASKS_DIR", "")
    harbor_trials_dir: str = os.environ.get("HARBOR_TRIALS_DIR", "/tmp/harbor_trials")
    agent_model_name: str = os.environ.get("AGENT_MODEL_NAME", "model")
    agent_timeout: int = int(os.environ.get("AGENT_TIMEOUT", "5400"))
    daytona_api_key_file: str = os.environ.get("DAYTONA_API_KEY_FILE", "")
    e2b_api_key_file: str = os.environ.get("E2B_API_KEY_FILE", "")
    modal_config_file: str = os.environ.get("MODAL_CONFIG_PATH", "")
    novita_api_key_file: str = os.environ.get("NOVITA_API_KEY_FILE", "")

    session_server_external_host: str = os.environ.get("SESSION_SERVER_EXTERNAL_HOST", "")
    session_server_workers: int = int(os.environ.get("SESSION_SERVER_WORKERS", "1"))
    miles_host_ip: str = os.environ.get("MILES_HOST_IP", "")

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.hf_checkpoint:
            raise ValueError("set MODEL_PATH or --hf-checkpoint")
        if not self.harbor_tasks_dir:
            self.harbor_tasks_dir = str(Path(__file__).with_name("harbor_tasks"))
        if not self.ref_load:
            self.ref_load = f"{self.base_dir.rstrip('/')}/{self.model_name}_torch_dist"
        if not self.save_traces_dir:
            self.save_traces_dir = os.environ.get(
                "MILES_DUMP_DIR", "/tmp/miles-miniswe-harbor/dump_details"
            )


def cleanup() -> None:
    my_pid = os.getpid()
    parent_pid = os.getppid()
    exclude = f"grep -v '^{my_pid}$' | grep -v '^{parent_pid}$'"
    for process_name in ("sglang", "train.py", "MegatronTrain"):
        subprocess.run(
            f"pgrep -f '{process_name}' | {exclude} | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null || true",
            shell=True,
            check=False,
        )
    time.sleep(5)


def prepare(args: ScriptArgs) -> None:
    backend = args.create_backend()
    backend.convert_checkpoint(
        model_name=args.model_name,
        megatron_model_type=args.megatron_model_type,
        num_gpus_per_node=args.num_gpus_per_node,
        dir_dst=args.base_dir,
        hf_checkpoint=args.hf_checkpoint,
        megatron_path=args.megatron_path,
        extra_args="--no-gradient-accumulation-fusion",
    )


def agent_train_args(args: ScriptArgs) -> str:
    external_host = ""
    if args.session_server_external_host:
        external_host = (
            f"--session-server-external-host {shlex.quote(args.session_server_external_host)} "
        )
    if args.sandbox_backend == "tencent_ags":
        agent_function = "tencent_harbor_agent.run"
    elif args.sandbox_backend == "e2b":
        agent_function = "harbor_agent_function.run"
    else:
        raise ValueError(
            f"unsupported SANDBOX_BACKEND={args.sandbox_backend!r}; use tencent_ags or e2b"
        )
    return (
        "--custom-generate-function-path miles.rollout.generate_hub.agentic_tool_call.generate "
        f"--custom-agent-function-path {agent_function} "
        "--custom-rm-path generate.reward_func "
        "--rollout-function-path generate.RolloutFn "
        "--dynamic-sampling-filter-path "
        "miles.rollout.filter_hub.dynamic_sampling_filters.check_no_aborted "
        "--tito-model qwen3 "
        "--use-session-server v2 "
        "--session-server-port 30000 "
        f"--session-server-workers {args.session_server_workers} "
        "--session-message-matcher strict "
        f"{external_host}"
    )


def execute(args: ScriptArgs) -> None:
    backend = args.create_backend()
    checkpoint_args = (
        f"--hf-checkpoint {shlex.quote(args.hf_checkpoint)} "
        f"--ref-load {shlex.quote(args.ref_load)} "
    )
    rollout_args = (
        f"--prompt-data {shlex.quote(args.prompt_data)} "
        "--input-key prompt "
        "--metadata-key metadata "
        "--rollout-shuffle "
        f"--num-rollout {args.num_rollout} "
        f"--rollout-batch-size {args.rollout_batch_size} "
        f"--n-samples-per-prompt {args.n_samples_per_prompt} "
        "--rollout-temperature 1.0 "
        "--rollout-max-response-len 4096 "
        f"--max-seq-len {args.max_seq_len} "
        f"--global-batch-size {args.global_batch_size} "
        "--balance-data "
    )
    performance_args = (
        "--tensor-model-parallel-size 4 "
        "--sequence-parallel "
        "--pipeline-model-parallel-size 1 "
        "--context-parallel-size 1 "
        "--expert-model-parallel-size 8 "
        "--expert-tensor-parallel-size 1 "
        "--recompute-granularity full "
        "--recompute-method uniform "
        "--recompute-num-layers 1 "
        "--no-gradient-accumulation-fusion "
        "--use-dynamic-batch-size "
        "--max-tokens-per-gpu 16384 "
        "--optimizer-cpu-offload "
        "--overlap-cpu-optimizer-d2h-h2d "
        "--use-precision-aware-optimizer "
    )
    grpo_args = (
        "--advantage-estimator grpo "
        "--use-kl-loss "
        "--kl-loss-coef 0.01 "
        "--kl-loss-type low_var_kl "
        "--entropy-coef 0.0 "
        "--eps-clip 0.2 "
        "--eps-clip-high 0.28 "
    )
    optimizer_args = (
        "--optimizer adam "
        "--lr 1e-6 "
        "--lr-decay-style constant "
        "--weight-decay 0.1 "
        "--adam-beta1 0.9 "
        "--adam-beta2 0.98 "
    )
    sglang_args = (
        "--rollout-num-gpus-per-engine 8 "
        "--sglang-mem-fraction-static 0.7 "
        "--sglang-cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 512 "
        "--sglang-tool-call-parser qwen25 "
        "--sglang-reasoning-parser qwen3 "
        "--sglang-router-port 31000 "
    )
    parallel_args = "--eval-global-batch-size 2 "
    misc_args = (
        "--attention-dropout 0.0 "
        "--hidden-dropout 0.0 "
        "--accumulate-allreduce-grads-in-fp32 "
        "--attention-softmax-in-fp32 "
        "--attention-backend flash "

"""Route the public Harbor agent function to the Tencent AGS environment."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import base64
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import harbor_agent_function
import harbor.agents.installed.mini_swe_agent as mini_swe_agent
from harbor.agents.installed.mini_swe_agent import MiniSweAgent


_original_environment_config = harbor_agent_function._environment_config
_INSTALL_TIMEOUT = int(os.getenv("TENCENT_AGS_AGENT_INSTALL_TIMEOUT", "1800"))
_UPLOAD_CHUNK_BYTES = int(os.getenv("TENCENT_AGS_UPLOAD_CHUNK_BYTES", str(32 * 1024 * 1024)))


async def _install_mini_swe_agent(self: MiniSweAgent, environment: Any) -> None:
    wheelhouse_tar = Path(os.environ["TENCENT_AGS_AGENT_WHEELHOUSE_TAR"]).expanduser()
    if not wheelhouse_tar.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "set TENCENT_AGS_AGENT_WHEELHOUSE_TAR to a Python 3.10 wheelhouse tar.gz"
        )

    sandbox = environment._sandbox
    with wheelhouse_tar.open("rb") as wheelhouse_file:
        part_index = 0
        while chunk := wheelhouse_file.read(_UPLOAD_CHUNK_BYTES):
            await sandbox.files.write(
                f"/tmp/agent-wheelhouse.tar.gz.part-{part_index:04d}",
                chunk,
                user="root",
                request_timeout=_INSTALL_TIMEOUT,
                use_octet_stream=True,
            )
            part_index += 1

    version_spec = f"=={self._version}" if self._version else ""
    output_cap_b64 = base64.b64encode(
        mini_swe_agent._OUTPUT_CAP_PATCH.format(
            cap_bytes=mini_swe_agent.MAX_COMMAND_OUTPUT_BYTES
        ).encode()
    ).decode()
    step_timing_b64 = base64.b64encode(
        mini_swe_agent._STEP_TIMING_PATCH.encode()
    ).decode()
    await self.exec_as_root(
        environment,
        command=(
            "set -euo pipefail; "
            "cat /tmp/agent-wheelhouse.tar.gz.part-* > /tmp/agent-wheelhouse.tar.gz; "
            "tar -xzf /tmp/agent-wheelhouse.tar.gz -C /tmp; "
            "/usr/bin/python3.10 -m pip install --no-index "
            "--find-links /tmp/agent-wheelhouse uv==0.7.13; "
            "export UV_OFFLINE=1; "
            'export PATH="/usr/local/bin:/root/.local/bin:$PATH"; '
            f"uv tool install mini-swe-agent{version_spec} "
            "--with 'litellm[proxy]' "
            "--find-links /tmp/agent-wheelhouse "
            "--python /usr/bin/python3.10; "
            'agent_python="$(uv tool dir)/mini-swe-agent/bin/python"; '
            f'echo {output_cap_b64} | base64 -d | "$agent_python" - && '
            f'echo {step_timing_b64} | base64 -d | "$agent_python" - && '
            "mini-swe-agent --help && "
            "/usr/bin/python3.10 -m pip install --no-index "
            "--find-links /tmp/agent-wheelhouse "
            "swebench==4.0.3 datasets==2.16.1 'fastcore<1.11'"
        ),
        env={"UV_OFFLINE": "1"},
        timeout_sec=_INSTALL_TIMEOUT,
    )


MiniSweAgent.install = _install_mini_swe_agent


def _environment_config():
    config = _original_environment_config()
    template = os.getenv("TENCENT_AGS_TEMPLATE", "").strip()
    if template:
        config.kwargs.setdefault("prebuilt_template_id", template)
    config.import_path = "tencent_ags_e2b:E2BEnvironment"
    return config


harbor_agent_function._environment_config = _environment_config


async def run(
    base_url: str,
    prompt: Any,
    request_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    public_session_url = os.getenv("SESSION_SERVER_PUBLIC_URL", "").strip().rstrip("/")
    if public_session_url:
        base_url = re.sub(r"^https?://[^/]+", public_session_url, base_url)
    return await harbor_agent_function.run(
        base_url,
        prompt,
        request_kwargs=request_kwargs,
        metadata=metadata,
        **kwargs,
    )

"""Parse actions & format observations with toolcalls"""

import json
import time

from jinja2 import StrictUndefined, Template

from minisweagent.exceptions import FormatError
from minisweagent.models.utils.openai_multimodal import expand_multimodal_content

BASH_TOOL = {
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "bash",
        "description": "Execute a bash command",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "command": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The bash command to execute",
                }
            },
            "required": ["command"],
        },
    },
}


def parse_toolcall_actions(
    tool_calls: list, *, format_error_template: str, template_kwargs: dict | None = None
) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse tool calls from the response. Raises FormatError if unknown tool or invalid args.

    ``template_kwargs`` are extra variables exposed to ``format_error_template`` (e.g.
    ``{"finish_reason": ...}`` so a template can distinguish a real format mistake from a
    ``max_tokens`` truncation).
    """
    template_kwargs = template_kwargs or {}
    if not tool_calls:
        raise FormatError(
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": Template(format_error_template, undefined=StrictUndefined).render(
                    error="No tool calls found in the response. Every response MUST include at least one tool call.",
                    actions=[],
                    has_tool_calls=False,
                    **template_kwargs,
                ),
                "extra": {"interrupt_type": "FormatError"},
            }
        )
    actions = []
    for tool_call in tool_calls:
        error_msg = ""
        args = {}
        try:
            args = json.loads(tool_call.function.arguments)
        except Exception as e:
            error_msg = f"Error parsing tool call arguments: {e}."
        if tool_call.function.name != "bash":
            error_msg += f"Unknown tool '{tool_call.function.name}'."
        if not isinstance(args, dict) or "command" not in args:
            error_msg += "Missing 'command' argument in bash tool call."
        if error_msg:
            raise FormatError(
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": Template(format_error_template, undefined=StrictUndefined).render(
                        actions=[], error=error_msg.strip(), has_tool_calls=True, **template_kwargs
                    ),
                    "extra": {"interrupt_type": "FormatError"},
                }
            )
        actions.append({"command": args["command"], "tool_call_id": tool_call.id})
    return actions


def format_toolcall_observation_messages(
    *,
    actions: list[dict],
    outputs: list[dict],
    observation_template: str,
    template_vars: dict | None = None,
    multimodal_regex: str = "",
) -> list[dict]:
    """Format execution outputs into tool result messages."""
    not_executed = {"output": "", "returncode": -1, "exception_info": "action was not executed"}
    padded_outputs = outputs + [not_executed] * (len(actions) - len(outputs))
    results = []
    for action, output in zip(actions, padded_outputs):
        content = Template(observation_template, undefined=StrictUndefined).render(
            output=output, **(template_vars or {})
        )
        msg = {
            "content": content,
            "extra": {
                "raw_output": output.get("output", ""),
                "returncode": output.get("returncode"),
                "timestamp": time.time(),
                "exception_info": output.get("exception_info"),
                **output.get("extra", {}),
            },
        }
        if "tool_call_id" in action:
            msg["tool_call_id"] = action["tool_call_id"]
            msg["role"] = "tool"
        else:
            msg["role"] = "user"  # human issued commands
        if multimodal_regex:
            msg = expand_multimodal_content(msg, pattern=multimodal_regex)
        results.append(msg)
    return results

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Aggregate Miles TITO-v2 leaf samples without assuming a fan-out cause."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import os
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DEFAULT_RESULTS = Path("/tmp/miles-miniswe-harbor")


def _as_float(value: Any) -> float | None:
    try:
        if value is None:
            return None
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def _mean(values: list[float]) -> float | None:
    return sum(values) / len(values) if values else None


def _rounded(value: float | None, digits: int = 3) -> float | None:
    return round(value, digits) if value is not None else None


def load_samples(dump_dir: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    import torch

    samples: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    paths = sorted(dump_dir.glob("rollout_data/*.pt"))
    for path in paths:
        payload = torch.load(path, weights_only=False, map_location="cpu")
        raw_samples = payload.get("samples", [])
        if not isinstance(raw_samples, list):
            raise AssertionError(f"{path} does not contain a sample list")
        for sample in raw_samples:
            if not isinstance(sample, dict):
                raise AssertionError(f"{path} contains a non-dict sample")
            sample = dict(sample)
            sample["dump_file"] = str(path)
            samples.append(sample)
    return samples


def build_records(samples: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    leaves: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for sample in samples:
        index = sample.get("index")
        if index is None:
            raise AssertionError("a rollout sample has no sample index")
        leaves[int(index)].append(sample)

    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for sample_index in sorted(leaves):
        leaf_rows = leaves[sample_index]
        metadata_rows = [row.get("metadata") or {} for row in leaf_rows]
        rewards = [value for row in leaf_rows if (value := _as_float(row.get("reward"))) is not None]
        response_lengths = [
            value
            for row in leaf_rows
            if (value := _as_float(row.get("response_length"))) is not None
        ]
        exit_statuses = [
            str(metadata.get("exit_status"))
            for metadata in metadata_rows
            if metadata.get("exit_status") is not None
        ]
        turns = [
            value
            for metadata in metadata_rows
            if (value := _as_float((metadata.get("agent_metrics") or {}).get("turns"))) is not None
        ]
        total_times = [
            value
            for metadata in metadata_rows
            if (value := _as_float((metadata.get("agent_metrics") or {}).get("total_time"))) is not None
        ]
        mismatches = [
            metadata.get("tito_session_mismatch")
            for metadata in metadata_rows
            if metadata.get("tito_session_mismatch") is not None
        ]
        trial_dirs = list(
            dict.fromkeys(
                metadata["trial_dir"]
                for metadata in metadata_rows
                if metadata.get("trial_dir")
            )
        )

        records.append(
            {
                "sample_index": sample_index,
                "group_index": leaf_rows[0].get("group_index"),
                "rollout_id": leaf_rows[0].get("rollout_id"),
                "leaf_count": len(leaf_rows),
                "statuses": [row.get("status") for row in leaf_rows],
                "exit_statuses": exit_statuses,
                "reward": _rounded(_mean(rewards)),
                "turns": _rounded(_mean(turns)),
                "response_length": _rounded(_mean(response_lengths)),
                "total_time": _rounded(_mean(total_times)),
                "tito_session_mismatch": mismatches,
                "has_tito_session_mismatch": bool(any(mismatches)),
                "trial_dirs": trial_dirs,
                "dump_files": list(
                    dict.fromkeys(
                        row["dump_file"] for row in leaf_rows if row.get("dump_file")
                    )
                ),
            }
        )
    return records


def build_summary(records: list[dict[str, Any]], samples: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    leaf_counts = [record["leaf_count"] for record in records]
    total_samples = len(samples)
    logical_rollouts = len(records)
    mismatch_records = [record for record in records if record["has_tito_session_mismatch"]]
    rewards = [record["reward"] for record in records if record["reward"] is not None]
    turns = [record["turns"] for record in records if record["turns"] is not None]
    total_times = [record["total_time"] for record in records if record["total_time"] is not None]
    exit_statuses = Counter(
        status
        for record in records
        for status in record["exit_statuses"]
    )
    statuses = Counter(
        status
        for sample in samples
        if (status := sample.get("status")) is not None
    )
    trial_dirs = {
        trial_dir
        for record in records
        for trial_dir in record["trial_dirs"]
    }

    expected_rollouts = int(os.environ.get("EXPECTED_LOGICAL_ROLLOUTS", "64"))
    return {
        "framework": "miles",
        "session_server": "v2",
        "message_matcher": "strict",
        "expected_logical_rollouts": expected_rollouts,
        "logical_rollouts": logical_rollouts,
        "training_samples": total_samples,
        "samples_per_logical_rollout": _rounded(total_samples / logical_rollouts)
        if logical_rollouts
        else None,
        "extra_training_samples": total_samples - logical_rollouts,
        "sample_inflation_ratio": _rounded(total_samples / logical_rollouts)
        if logical_rollouts
        else None,
        "fanout_rollouts": sum(count > 1 for count in leaf_counts),
        "max_leaves_per_logical_rollout": max(leaf_counts, default=0),
        "mismatch_rollouts": len(mismatch_records),
        "tito_session_mismatch_rate": _rounded(len(mismatch_records) / logical_rollouts)
        if logical_rollouts
        else None,
        "reward_mean": _rounded(_mean(rewards)),
        "positive_reward_rollouts": sum(value > 0 for value in rewards),
        "turns_mean": _rounded(_mean(turns)),
        "total_time_mean_seconds": _rounded(_mean(total_times)),
        "sample_statuses": dict(sorted(statuses.items())),
        "exit_statuses": dict(sorted(exit_statuses.items())),
        "harbor_trials": len(trial_dirs),
        "logical_rollout_count_complete": logical_rollouts == expected_rollouts,
    }


def main() -> int:
    results_dir = Path(
        os.environ.get("AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS", str(DEFAULT_RESULTS))
    )
    dump_dir = Path(
        os.environ.get("MILES_DUMP_DIR", str(results_dir / "dump_details"))
    )
    log_dir = results_dir / "experiment_logs"
    log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    samples = load_samples(dump_dir)
    if not samples:
        raise AssertionError(f"no Miles rollout samples found under {dump_dir}")

    records = build_records(samples)
    summary = build_summary(records, samples)
    summary["observation"] = (
        "fanout_observed" if summary["fanout_rollouts"] else "no_fanout_observed"
    )
    summary["records_path"] = str(log_dir / "rollout_records.jsonl")
    summary["dump_dir"] = str(dump_dir)

    records_path = log_dir / "rollout_records.jsonl"
    records_path.write_text(
        "".join(
            json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) + "
"
            for record in records
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    metrics_path = log_dir / "metrics.json"
    metrics_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "
",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    if summary["training_samples"] < summary["logical_rollouts"]:
        raise AssertionError("training sample count cannot be lower than logical rollout count")
    if not math.isfinite(summary["sample_inflation_ratio"] or 0):
        raise AssertionError("invalid sample inflation ratio")

    print(
        "PASS: observation complete; "
        f"training_samples/logical_rollouts={summary['sample_inflation_ratio']}x, "
        f"fanout_rollouts={summary['fanout_rollouts']}/{summary['logical_rollouts']}, "
        f"mismatch_rollouts={summary['mismatch_rollouts']}/{summary['logical_rollouts']}"
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Session state over the trajectory tree: always-branch serving.

This module is the serving policy on top. A request is never rejected for mismatching stored history and never
destroys anything: it attaches at the deepest matching node, its unmatched
suffix becomes the new branch's delta, and whatever is not a clean
extension just grows a sibling or a new root. Whether a branch was a retry
is decided later by the sample_picker, not here.

Concurrency contract: single lock on the whole tree. A commit only appends a new
node under the parent the request attached to, so concurrent generations from
the same spot become sibling nodes instead of a conflict.

The tree is the whole state. Serving a request is
``prepare_token_ids_and_request_args`` (``attach_point_for_request``, pure: which
node the request continues; the request args against that node's ``turn_args``;
the prompt rendered under that node) and then ``commit_generation`` under that
node. What ``GET /sessions`` shows as a single chain is
``SessionStateV2.latest()``, the most recently committed generation's path —
derived, never stored.
"""

import asyncio
import logging
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from miles.rollout.session.config import SessionServerConfig
from miles.rollout.session.errors import MessageValidationError, TokenizationError, TruncatedGenerationError
from miles.rollout.session.linear_trajectory import SessionRegistry, assert_pretokenized_prefix
from miles.rollout.session.request_args import PreparedChatRequest, prepare_chat_request
from miles.rollout.session.types import SessionRecord
from miles.rollout.session.v2.tree_trajectory import AttachPoint, SessionTree, TrajectoryNode
from miles.utils.chat_template_utils.message_matcher_hub import SessionMessageMatcher
from miles.utils.chat_template_utils.tito_tokenizer import TITOTokenizer, extract_template_args

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class SessionStateV2:
    """Per-session concurrency container plus the trajectory forest.

    The forest is the whole state; ``latest()`` derives the single chain that
    ``GET /sessions`` serves. A failed first turn commits nothing, so the
    session stays fully retryable.
    """

    lock: asyncio.Lock = field(default_factory=asyncio.Lock, repr=False, compare=False)
    closing: bool = field(default=False, repr=False, compare=False)
    tree: SessionTree = field(default_factory=SessionTree)
    evaluation: bool = False
    sampling_defaults: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    sampling_support_replay: bool = False

    def latest(self) -> TrajectoryNode | None:
        """The most recently committed generation (always a leaf), or ``None``
        before the first commit. Its root->node path is the single-chain view."""
        return self.tree.nodes[-1] if self.tree.nodes else None


def attach_point_for_request(
    state: SessionStateV2,
    request_messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    message_matcher: SessionMessageMatcher | None = None,
) -> AttachPoint:
    """Where *request_messages* attaches: the deepest node whose path is a
    prefix of the request, ``node=None`` for a new root. Pure; raises 409 when
    that node is a truncated generation."""
    attach = state.tree.find_attach_point(request_messages, message_matcher=message_matcher)

    if attach.node is not None and attach.node.truncated:
        raise TruncatedGenerationError(
            "truncated generation cannot be extended: the matched node ended with "
            "finish_reason='length' and truncation closes that path for good; "
            "branch before the cut instead"
        )

    if attach.node is not state.latest():
        logger.debug(
            "Branching: request(%d msgs) attaches at node seq=%s "
            "(matched %d msgs, best overlap %d), tree has %d nodes",
            len(request_messages),
            attach.node.seq if attach.node is not None else "<new root>",
            attach.matched_messages,
            attach.best_overlap,
            len(state.tree.nodes),
        )
    return attach


def prepare_token_ids_and_request_args(
    state: SessionStateV2,
    client_args: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    config: SessionServerConfig,
    tito_tokenizer: TITOTokenizer,
    message_matcher: SessionMessageMatcher | None = None,
) -> tuple[PreparedChatRequest, TrajectoryNode | None]:
    """Return the prepared request with `body["input_ids"]` and its parent for `commit_generation`."""
    request_messages = client_args.get("messages", [])
    parent = attach_point_for_request(state, request_messages, message_matcher=message_matcher).node
    prepared = prepare_chat_request(
        client_args,
        tito_tokenizer,
        config=config,
        turn_args=parent.turn_args if parent is not None else None,
        evaluation=state.evaluation,
        sampling_defaults=state.sampling_defaults,
        sampling_support_replay=state.sampling_support_replay,
    )
    prepared.body["input_ids"] = _render_token_ids(
        parent, request_messages, template_args=prepared.template_args, tito_tokenizer=tito_tokenizer
    )
    return prepared, parent


def _render_token_ids(
    parent: TrajectoryNode | None,
    request_messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    template_args: dict[str, Any],
    tito_tokenizer: TITOTokenizer,
) -> list[int]:
    """Build prompt token IDs for a request extending `parent`.

    Use `template_args` for newly rendered tokens.

    - No parent (new root): render the whole request from scratch.
    - Otherwise: reuse the parent's token snapshot as-is and tokenize only
      the new suffix on top — the shared prefix is never re-rendered.
    """
    if parent is None:
        return tito_tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            request_messages,
            add_generation_prompt=True,
            tokenize=True,
            template_args=template_args,
        )

    stored = parent.path_messages()
    _validate_suffix_roles(request_messages[len(stored) :], tito_tokenizer)
    effective_messages = stored + request_messages[len(stored) :]
    return tito_tokenizer.merge_tokens(
        old_messages=stored,
        new_messages=effective_messages,
        pretokenized_token_ids=parent.token_ids,
        template_args=template_args,
    )


def _validate_suffix_roles(
    suffix: list[dict[str, Any]],
    tito_tokenizer: TITOTokenizer,
) -> None:
    allowed = set(tito_tokenizer.allowed_append_roles)
    for message in suffix:
        role = message.get("role")
        if role not in allowed:
            raise MessageValidationError(
                f"appended message role={role!r} not allowed "
                f"(allowed={sorted(set(tito_tokenizer.allowed_append_roles))}); "
                "the selected TITO fixed template does not support appending this role"
            )


def commit_generation(
    state: SessionStateV2,
    *,
    parent: TrajectoryNode | None,
    request_messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
    assistant_message: dict[str, Any],
    prompt_token_ids: list[int],
    completion_token_ids: list[int],
    max_trim_tokens: int,
    record: SessionRecord,
    response_id: str,
    finish_reason: str,
    turn_args: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> TrajectoryNode:
    """Validate and append one generation under *parent* (the request's attach
    node). Prefix validation is byte-identical to the pre-tree checkpoint check.
    ``turn_args`` is the full resolved request for this generation."""
    all_token_ids = prompt_token_ids + completion_token_ids
    assert_pretokenized_prefix(
        parent.token_ids if parent is not None else [],
        all_token_ids,
        max_trim_tokens=max_trim_tokens,
        request_messages=request_messages,
        assistant_message=assistant_message,
    )

    parent_messages = parent.path_messages() if parent is not None else []
    delta = list(request_messages[len(parent_messages) :]) + [assistant_message]
    node = state.tree.create_node(
        parent,
        delta_messages=delta,
        token_ids=all_token_ids,
        completion_span=(len(prompt_token_ids), len(all_token_ids)),
        committed_at=record.timestamp,
        response_id=response_id,
        record=record,
        finish_reason=finish_reason,
        turn_args=turn_args,
    )
    return node


class SessionRegistryV2(SessionRegistry):
    """Session ID -> session state mapping with shared tokenizer resources.

    The v1 registry shell (CRUD + tokenizer resources) with the session type
    swapped to ``SessionStateV2``; all session mutations go through the
    module-level serving functions, called by the route handler under
    ``SessionStateV2.lock``.
    """

    sessions: dict[str, SessionStateV2]

    def create_session(
        self,
        *,
        evaluation: bool = False,
        sampling_defaults: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        sampling_support_replay: bool = False,
    ) -> str:
        session_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.sessions[session_id] = SessionStateV2(
            evaluation=evaluation,
            sampling_defaults=dict(sampling_defaults or {}),
            sampling_support_replay=sampling_support_replay,
        )
        return session_id

    def compute_mismatch(
        self,
        messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
        token_ids: list[int],
        *,
        turn_args: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> list[dict] | None:
        """Compare accumulated token IDs against canonical chat template
        output for one path using its leaf's recorded renderer fields. Read-only."""
        if not token_ids:
            return None
        try:
            # Mismatch checks have no request args to resolve. Re-render from
            # the renderer fields in the full request recorded for this turn.
            expected_ids = self.tito_tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
                messages,
                add_generation_prompt=False,
                tokenize=True,
                template_args=extract_template_args(turn_args),
            )
            mismatches = self.comparator.compare_sequences(expected_ids, token_ids)
            return [m.to_dict() for m in mismatches]
        except Exception as e:
            raise TokenizationError(f"failed to compute tito_session_mismatch: {e}") from e

    def compute_session_mismatch(self, state: SessionStateV2) -> list[dict] | None:
        """``compute_mismatch`` over the latest committed generation's path."""
        node = state.latest()
        if node is None:
            return None
        return self.compute_mismatch(node.path_messages(), node.token_ids, turn_args=node.turn_args)
from miles.utils.types import Sample

_SERVER_OWNED_METADATA_KEYS = ("accumulated_token_ids", "tito_session_mismatch", "leaf", "turn_args")


def check_input_metadata(agent_metadata: dict) -> dict:
    return {key: value for key, value in agent_metadata.items() if key not in _SERVER_OWNED_METADATA_KEYS}


def assign_reward(samples: list[Sample], trajectory_reward: float) -> None:
    for sample in samples:
        sample.reward = trajectory_reward


def default_postprocess(leaf_samples: list[Sample], session_metadata: dict) -> list[Sample]:
    """Finalize the leaf samples kept by the picker.

    A shared completion is trainable only in the earliest committed kept leaf.
    Ownership is computed after picking, so a dropped leaf cannot own it.

    Agent metadata cannot replace server-owned fields. A provided trajectory reward is assigned to every kept sample.

    Mutates each `Sample` in place and preserves picker order.
    """
    nodes_by_id = {node["id"]: node for node in session_metadata["tree"]["nodes"]}
    agent_metadata = session_metadata.get("agent") or {}
    trajectory_reward = agent_metadata.get("reward")
    agent_sample_metadata = check_input_metadata(agent_metadata)

    # Picker order may change; `node_id` preserves commit order.
    owner_by_node_id: dict[int, int] = {}
    for sample in leaf_samples:
        leaf = sample.metadata["leaf"]
        leaf_id = leaf["node_id"]
        for node_id in leaf["path_node_ids"]:
            owner_by_node_id[node_id] = min(leaf_id, owner_by_node_id.get(node_id, leaf_id))

    processed_samples: list[Sample] = []
    for sample in leaf_samples:
        leaf = sample.metadata["leaf"]
        response_start = len(sample.tokens) - sample.response_length
        # Spans index all tokens; `loss_mask` indexes only the response.
        # Clamp when early-stop or truncation shortens the sample.
        for node_id in leaf["path_node_ids"]:
            if owner_by_node_id[node_id] == leaf["node_id"]:
                continue
            completion_start, completion_end = nodes_by_id[node_id]["completion_span"]
            mask_start = max(completion_start - response_start, 0)
            mask_end = min(completion_end - response_start, sample.response_length)
            if mask_end > mask_start:
                sample.loss_mask[mask_start:mask_end] = [0] * (mask_end - mask_start)
        server_metadata = {key: sample.metadata[key] for key in _SERVER_OWNED_METADATA_KEYS if key in sample.metadata}
        sample.metadata = {**sample.metadata, **agent_sample_metadata, **server_metadata}
        processed_samples.append(sample)
    # Skip `assign_reward` to score downstream, or replace the scalar
    # `agent_metadata["reward"]` for finer-grained assignment.
    if trajectory_reward is not None:
        assign_reward(processed_samples, trajectory_reward)
    return processed_samples
"""
Generic agentic generate function for agent-environment RL training.

The agent logic is fully encapsulated in a user-provided async function
(--custom-agent-function-path). This generate function only handles:
  1. TITO session tracing (OpenAIEndpointTracer)
  2. Collecting the worker-assembled training samples (the session server
     converts records to samples, truncates and merges in the owning worker)
  3. Driver-side metadata application (agent_metadata, session_metadata)

Agent function contract:
  async def my_agent(
      base_url: str,
      prompt: ...,
      request_kwargs: dict,
      metadata: dict,       # sample.metadata — env-specific fields
      **kwargs,
  ) -> dict | None:
      ...

  Returning None means no extra metadata to attach.
  Returning a dict merges it into every sample's metadata, so downstream
  reward models (--custom-rm-path) can read whatever the agent left there.
"""

import argparse
import logging
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from copy import deepcopy
from typing import Any

import httpx
from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import ChatCompletionRequest

from miles.rollout.base_types import GenerateFnInput, GenerateFnOutput
from miles.rollout.generate_utils.openai_endpoint_utils import OpenAIEndpointTracer
from miles.rollout.session.v2.metrics import SESSION_ROLLOUT_METRICS_KEY
from miles.utils.function_registry import load_function
from miles.utils.types import Sample

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def generate(input: GenerateFnInput) -> GenerateFnOutput:
    assert not input.args.partial_rollout, "Partial rollout is not supported"
    assert getattr(input.args, "session_server_instances", None), (
        "agentic_tool_call.generate requires session_server_instances. "
        "Pass --use-session-server to start the session server."
    )
    use_v2 = getattr(input.args, "use_session_server", None) == "v2"
    collect_spec_metrics = use_v2 and input.args.sglang_speculative_algorithm is not None
    tracer = await OpenAIEndpointTracer.create(
        input.args, evaluation=input.evaluation, sampling_params=input.sampling_params
    )

    custom_agent_function: Callable = load_function(input.args.custom_agent_function_path)
    assert (
        custom_agent_function is not None
    ), f"Custom agent function {input.args.custom_agent_function_path} not found"

    max_seq_len = getattr(input.args, "max_seq_len", None)

    metadata = input.sample.metadata
    if max_seq_len is not None:
        metadata = {**metadata, "max_seq_len": max_seq_len}
    if tracer.session_server_instance_id:
        metadata = {**metadata, "session_server_instance_id": tracer.session_server_instance_id}

    log_prefix = f"[session={tracer.session_id}]"

    # From the tracer, not args: with multiple instances the owning ip:port is per-session.
    metadata = {**metadata, "session_server_id": tracer.session_server_id}

    agent_metadata = None
    collect_failed = False
    t_start = time.monotonic()
    try:
        logger.debug(f"{log_prefix} Starting agent function call")
        agent_metadata = await custom_agent_function(
            base_url=tracer.agent_base_url,
            prompt=input.sample.prompt,
            request_kwargs=build_chat_request_kwargs(input.sampling_params),
            metadata=metadata,
        )
        logger.debug(f"{log_prefix} Agent function returned in {time.monotonic()-t_start:.1f}s")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"{log_prefix} Agent function failed: {e}", exc_info=True)

    finally:
        # Collect even if the agent failed.
        logger.debug(f"{log_prefix} Calling collect_samples...")
        collect_kwargs = {"max_seq_len": max_seq_len}
        if use_v2:
            collect_kwargs["agent_metadata"] = agent_metadata
        try:
            result = await tracer.collect_samples(input.sample, **collect_kwargs)
        # Costs this sample, not the run; a non-2xx still raises RuntimeError.
        except (TimeoutError, httpx.TransportError) as e:
            collect_failed = True
            logger.warning(f"{log_prefix} Failed collecting samples: {e!r}", exc_info=True)
        else:
            logger.debug(
                f"{log_prefix} collect_samples done: {len(result.samples)} samples, "
                f"total_time={time.monotonic()-t_start:.1f}s"
            )

    if collect_failed:
        sample = deepcopy(input.sample)
        sample.status = Sample.Status.ABORTED
        if collect_spec_metrics:
            sample.metadata.pop(SESSION_ROLLOUT_METRICS_KEY, None)
        return GenerateFnOutput(samples=[sample] if use_v2 else sample)

    if not result.samples:
        if result.empty_reason == "all_truncated":
            logger.warning("All samples truncated (prompt already exceeds max_seq_len)")
        else:
            logger.warning("No model calls recorded for sample")
        sample = deepcopy(input.sample)
        sample.status = Sample.Status.ABORTED
        if collect_spec_metrics:
            sample.metadata.pop(SESSION_ROLLOUT_METRICS_KEY, None)
        return GenerateFnOutput(samples=[sample] if use_v2 else sample)

    session_rollout_metrics = None
    if collect_spec_metrics:
        session_rollout_metrics = result.session_metadata[SESSION_ROLLOUT_METRICS_KEY]
        if session_rollout_metrics["session_id"] != tracer.session_id:
            raise ValueError(
                "session_rollout_metrics.session_id does not match the collected session: "
                f"{session_rollout_metrics['session_id']!r} != {tracer.session_id!r}"
            )
        if session_rollout_metrics["metrics"] is None:
            raise ValueError("a successful session collect must carry metrics")

    samples = result.samples
    if collect_spec_metrics:
        for sample in samples:
            sample.metadata.pop(SESSION_ROLLOUT_METRICS_KEY, None)
            sample.metadata[SESSION_ROLLOUT_METRICS_KEY] = session_rollout_metrics
    if use_v2 and len(samples) > 1:
        # FIXME: handle sample index issues.
        rollout_id = input.sample.rollout_id if input.sample.rollout_id is not None else input.sample.index
        assert rollout_id is not None, "v2 agentic samples require input Sample.rollout_id or Sample.index"
        for sample in samples:
            sample.rollout_id = rollout_id
    if not use_v2:
        # v1: the agent's metadata is applied driver-side. Under v2 it traveled
        # through collect_samples and came back applied by the server-side
        # merge (per-sample metadata/reward on the wire) — no overlay here.
        for s in samples:
            s.metadata.update(agent_metadata or {})

    # If the agent function reports wall-clock time spent outside policy generation
    # (env/tool steps), surface it on Sample.non_generation_time so throughput
    # accounting subtracts it.
    ngt = ((agent_metadata or {}).get("agent_metrics") or {}).get("total_tool_time")
    if ngt is not None:
        for s in samples:
            s.non_generation_time = ngt

    if use_v2:
        return GenerateFnOutput(samples=samples)

    (sample,) = samples
    sample.metadata.update(result.session_metadata)
    return GenerateFnOutput(samples=sample)


def _add_arguments(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser):
    parser.add_argument("--custom-agent-function-path", type=str)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--max-seq-len",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        dest="max_seq_len",
        help="Max sequence length in tokens (prompt + completion, including env responses) "
        "per session. Truncation happens inside the session server during sample assembly; "
        "also forwarded to the Harbor agent server (as max_seq_len) to abort the trial early.",
    )


generate.add_arguments = _add_arguments


# Process keys to match ChatCompletionRequest input
def build_chat_request_kwargs(sampling_params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    request_kwargs = dict(sampling_params)
    key_map = {
        "max_new_tokens": "max_tokens",
        "min_new_tokens": "min_tokens",
        "sampling_seed": "seed",
    }
    for src, dst in key_map.items():
        if src in request_kwargs:
            if dst not in request_kwargs:
                request_kwargs[dst] = request_kwargs[src]
            request_kwargs.pop(src, None)

    reserved_keys = {"model", "messages"}
    allowed_keys = set(ChatCompletionRequest.model_fields) - reserved_keys
    return {key: value for key, value in request_kwargs.items() if key in allowed_keys and value is not None}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Select complete SWE-bench Verified records and Miles prompt rows."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path


EXCLUDED_INSTANCE_IDS = {
    "astropy__astropy-7606",
    "django__django-10097",
    "scikit-learn__scikit-learn-14710",
    "sphinx-doc__sphinx-8595",
    "sphinx-doc__sphinx-9711",
}


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--dataset", default="princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified")
    parser.add_argument("--split", default="test")
    parser.add_argument("--num-tasks", type=int, default=16)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    return parser.parse_args()


def select_round_robin(rows: list[dict], count: int) -> list[dict]:
    by_repo: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        if str(row["instance_id"]) in EXCLUDED_INSTANCE_IDS:
            continue
        by_repo[str(row["repo"])].append(row)

    selected: list[dict] = []
    cursor = 0
    while len(selected) < count:
        repositories = [repo for repo in by_repo if cursor < len(by_repo[repo])]
        if not repositories:
            break
        for repo in sorted(repositories):
            if len(selected) >= count:
                break
            selected.append(by_repo[repo][cursor])
        cursor += 1
    return selected


def write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        "".join(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in rows),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()
    from datasets import load_dataset

    dataset = load_dataset(args.dataset, split=args.split)
    rows = list(dataset)
    selected = select_round_robin(rows, args.num_tasks)
    if len(selected) != args.num_tasks:
        raise AssertionError(f"requested {args.num_tasks} tasks, selected {len(selected)}")

    instance_ids = [str(row["instance_id"]) for row in selected]
    if len(set(instance_ids)) != len(instance_ids):
        raise AssertionError("selected instance IDs are not unique")

    prompt_rows = [
        {
            "prompt": row["problem_statement"],
            "metadata": {
                "instance_id": row["instance_id"],
                "agent_name": "mini-swe-agent",
            },
        }
        for row in selected
    ]

    output_dir = args.output_dir
    write_jsonl(output_dir / "swebench_verified.jsonl", selected)
    write_jsonl(output_dir / "miles_prompts.jsonl", prompt_rows)
    (output_dir / "selected_instance_ids.txt").write_text(
        "".join(f"{instance_id}\n" for instance_id in instance_ids),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(f"selected {len(selected)} SWE-bench Verified instances")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Frozen "'`observed_run/experiment_logs/metrics.json` reports exactly: `expected_logical_rollouts: 64`, `logical_rollouts: 64`, `harbor_trials: 64`, `logical_rollout_count_complete: true`; `training_samples: 164`, `extra_training_samples: 100`, `sample_inflation_ratio: 2.562`, `samples_per_logical_rollout: 2.562`; `fanout_rollouts: 30`, `max_leaves_per_logical_rollout: 21`; `mismatch_rollouts: 56`, `tito_session_mismatch_rate: 0.875`; `sample_statuses: {"completed": 128, "truncated": 36}`. Rewards are `reward_mean: 0.0`, `positive_reward_rollouts: 0`; leaf-level `exit_statuses` are `{"AgentError": 97, "Submitted": 67}`, not counts of distinct trials. The concrete accounting cause is MiniSWE 2.4.6’s non-append-only request history on format-error recovery. In `mini_swe_agent/src/minisweagent/models/litellm_model.py`, `query()` parses actions before returning the assistant message. `models/utils/actions_toolcall.py` raises `FormatError` containing a user correction for absent/invalid tool calls. The model catches it, saves the raw response under that correction’s `extra.response`, and rethrows. Consequently `agents/default.py` never reaches its normal assistant `add_messages(message)`; its run loop appends the correction instead. `_prepare_messages_for_api()` removes `extra`, so the rejected assistant response is preserved diagnostically but absent from the next API request. Successful commands follow the normal assistant/tool-observation cycle.

TITO has already committed that generation. In Miles `rollout/session/v2/tree_trajectory.py` and `session_state.py`, attachment requires a complete stored message path to be a prefix of the new request. Replacing the expected assistant message with a user correction prevents attachment to the latest node. The request attaches to an earlier matching ancestor, or becomes another root; the rejected generation remains a leaf. This append-only forest deliberately preserves branches. The configured `drop_same_prompt_retries` picker removes identical-prompt retries, but the correction changes the prompt, so these branches survive. `core.py` assembles one sample per retained leaf, and `agentic_tool_call.generate` collects even after agent failure while retaining logical rollout identity. Default postprocessing masks shared completions already owned by another leaf; it does not collapse leaf counts. Thus 64 episodes can yield 164 samples without 164 tasks or duplicated training loss on every shared prefix.

Trajectory evidence supports this mechanism: rollout/sample 1, `pylint-dev__pylint-4551__20261117-042936__FWbRKkX`, has two “No tool calls found” user corrections in its MiniSWE text log (also folded into observations in the converted Harbor trajectory), three leaves, and no TITO mismatch. Sample 33, `django__django-10554__20261117-042934__VNVsHzc`, has 20 tool-call-error observations and the maximum 21 leaves. These illustrate the mechanism, not a claim that every extra leaf maps one-to-one to a visible converted error.

Alternative explanations do not account for this result. The launcher and frozen invocation agree on Qwen3-30B-A3B, normal mode, one rollout/update budget, 16 prompts × 4 samples, response cap 4096, Qwen `qwen25` tool parser, `qwen3` reasoning parser/TITO, and strict v2 matching. Parsed bash calls and returned command outputs demonstrate working parser and sandbox round trips. The Tencent wrapper changes environment installation/routing, not message-history recovery; tool-command timeouts and remote cost-map fallback warnings are not evidence of transport-created branches. Trial configs show exactly four trials for each of the 16 fixed repository-round-robin SWE-bench Verified tasks, excluding the listed known outliers.

Residual tokenization discrepancies are separate diagnostics: `compute_mismatch()` compares accumulated tokens with a canonical re-render after attachment; it does not choose branches. Records include thinking-boundary/newline differences. Of 64 rollouts, 27 have mismatches but only one leaf, while the three-leaf pylint example has none; mismatch is neither necessary nor sufficient for fan-out. Finally, the frozen driver/events show training failing later in `_compute_log_prob` with FlashAttention/CuTe `TypeError: fmax() takes 2 positional arguments but 3 positional arguments (and 3 keyword-only arguments) were given`. That independent kernel/API failure does not explain the previously collected leaves; nor do zero rewards establish a single cause shared with fan-out.
